claim: The AI Assistant button lets editors pick fields, add keywords and keep working while drafting runs in the background
Nothing reaches the live site until the editor reviews and saves
An administrator picks the AI service, key, allowed models and brand voice
Brand voice holds a tone, words to avoid and examples, and guides suggestions
Works with your own account or a self-hosted Ollama
Background processing has to be running
Emails and phone numbers are masked by default, names and addresses are not
Title and description options and a content draft come back in the chosen language version
Providers are OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and Ollama
Prompt templates are editable and can each be switched on or off
The key is stored encrypted and never shown again
Request and result text is cleared after 30 days and a usage record stays
A read-only catalogue screen lists AI features under System
